description: Java class for a message transformation node in Thingsboard rule engine, utilizing scripting for message payload, metadata, and type modification.

classes.name: TbTransformMsgNode
classes.description: A node that transforms messages using scripting, allowing modification of message payload, metadata, and type.

methods.name: loadNodeConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and initializes the node configuration, setting up the scripting engine based on configuration.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Executes the script to transform the message asynchronously.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroying the scripting engine if initialized.
